verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows the Claude Code CLI runs locally only as a client that authenticates against Anthropic-hosted services (a claude.ai login, a Console API key, or a cloud provider). Nothing documents a way to run the core product on your own infrastructure, and a community comment notes it is not FOSS, unlike Codex CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
